data.gender_notes: Mubarez is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-r-z' which means 'to separate, to free, to make distinct'. This name holds a spiritual significance for Muslims, symbolizing the release from worldly desires and attachment towards Allah. The name Mubarez carries the meaning “Free, Clear, Distinct” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubarez usually hope their child will grow to embody free, clear, distinct and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubarez total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
